title: The projection formula for a proper morphism with torsion coefficients over the ring of integers
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the projection formula Rf_*E tensor^L_Z K = Rf_*(E tensor^L_Z f^{-1}K) for a proper morphism and torsion coefficients over Z (statement lines 19000-19010). The proof (proof lines 19012-19051) verifies the canonical map on stalks, where the right-hand side becomes E_x tensor^L_Z K_y, records the vanishing range coming from global dimension one and the torsion property of the tensor complex, and applies the pull-out lemma over the ring of integers to conclude. H2: one stalk computation followed by a pull-out step, written out.
